usage: fleet-switchboard pr-state [-h] [--json] pr

Reads the daemon's cached picture of the PR (pr-state.json) and the local
ledger, and prints one line. It never calls GitHub: a PR the daemon has not
cached is 'unknown'. Use it instead of polling GitHub in a shell loop; wait
with `remind`.

positional arguments:
  pr          The pull request: owner/repo#N or its URL

options:
  -h, --help  show this help message and exit
  --json      The same, as one JSON object
